title: City Bikes – how it works
text:
CITY BIKES – HOW IT WORKS

City Bikes are a cheap and easy way to get around the city. There are 80 stations in the city centre and near the university.

1. Download the City Bikes app and create an account. You need a bank card.
2. Find a station near you on the map in the app.
3. Scan the code on the bike to unlock it.
4. Enjoy your ride! Remember to ride on the bike paths, not on the pavement.
5. When you finish, return the bike to any station and lock it.

Prices: The first 20 minutes are free. After that, every 30 minutes cost 2 zł. A day ticket costs 15 zł.

Important information:
• You must be 16 or older to rent a bike.
• Bikes are available from April to November.
• If the bike has a problem, report it in the app and leave it at the station.
• If you don't return the bike in 12 hours, you will pay a fine of 200 zł.

Have a safe ride!
